Senior Mechanical Engineer | Building Services Consultancy   
  About the Role  
 Are you an experienced  Mechanical Engineer  looking for a platform to lead high-profile HVAC design projects and shape the future of Melbourne's built environment? 
 We are a thriving, multidisciplinary building services consulting firm known for delivering innovative, sustainable, and energy-efficient engineering solutions across commercial, healthcare, educational, residential, and institutional sectors. 
 We are seeking a  Senior Mechanical Engineer  to take technical ownership of complex mechanical and HVAC projects from concept through to completion, build strong relationships with key stakeholders, and help guide the next generation of engineering talent. 
  Key Responsibilities  
 
 
 Lead the detailed design and delivery of mechanical services (HVAC, ventilation, central plant systems, smoke control, and thermal comfort modeling) across diverse property sectors. 
 
 
 Act as the primary technical contact for clients, architects, builders, and project managers. 
 
 
 Oversee site inspections, commissioning reviews, and contractor submittals during construction phases. 
 
 
 Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and intermediate mechanical engineers within the team. 
 
 
 Assist directors with project fee proposals, resource planning, and client engagement. 
 
 
  About You  
 
 
 Bachelor of Engineering (Mechanical) or equivalent. 
 
 
 6+ years of local experience within an Australian building services engineering consultancy. 
 
 
 Strong command of HVAC system design, heat load calculations and relevant Australian Standards. 
 
 
 Familiarity with Revit (BIM environment) and energy/thermal simulation tools. 
 
 
 CPEng / NER status or eligibility for Victorian Professional Engineer registration (Building Services) is highly desirable. 
 
 
 Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to present ideas clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
 
 
  What We Offer  
 
 
 Flexible working arrangements, including work-from-home options and early Friday finishes. 
 
 
 Clear, structured pathways toward Associate or Principal roles. 
 
 
 A collaborative, inclusive atmosphere with regular social outings, technical knowledge-sharing, and wellness benefits. 
 
 
 Above-market salary package, annual performance bonuses, and continuous professional development support. 
 
 
   

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.

TEJ Engineering is a new team shaping excellence and redefining the service standards for Structural Mechanical and Piping services. Our proficient and accomplished team comprises of the best multiskilled trades people committed to achieving our "no rework" principle.

- Conduct scheduled inspections to assess equipment condition, detect early signs of mechanical failure, and troubleshoot operational issues.

The successful applicants will be offered a salary between $78,000 - $90,000 dependant on experience.
